title: On-demand attestation generator + pricing trigger pilot for faster SIG/CAIQ responses
creator: Evan Morris
description: Problem: Enterprise customers frequently stall procurement while waiting for tailored SIG/CAIQ evidence. Legal/SE teams spend hours compiling X- and Y- documents, extending sales cycles and increasing support load. Goal: run a pilot that lets customers self-generate a curated SIG/CAIQ evidence bundle through the Redwood Console and optionally trigger a small pricing/credit action (eg. one-time attestation credit or gating to an enterprise pricing tier) to accelerate contract close without heavy manual involvement.
background: We currently maintain canonical SIG/CAIQ responses and an internal attestation team that curates evidence for large deals. This is accurate but costly and slow. Similar past work focused on answer libraries and bundled attestations, but customers still ask for tailored artifacts and proof-of-controls. The team has received repeated feedback that a fast, interactive self-serve flow would remove a major procurement blocker for SMB and mid-market accounts.
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight Console flow that guides authorized customer admins through: 1) selecting the scope (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) declaring environment and encryption choices via simple checkboxes, 3) pulling pre-approved evidence artifacts (network diagrams, KMS config snippets, SOC/ISO summaries) and generating a condensed SIG/CAIQ bundle PDF and machine-readable answers JSON. Include an optional product action: upon bundle generation, grant a one-time 'attestation credit' usable against a Dedicated reservation or professional services, or mark the account as 'attestation-enabled' to unlock an enterprise pricing conversation flag. The backend will call an internal attestation service (ENG-5109) to verify evidence availability and stamp the bundle. Audit log entries and an admin approval path must be included for higher-risk controls.
acceptance_criteria:
- Console flow prototype live behind a feature flag for a small pilot cohort
- Generated SIG/CAIQ PDF and answers JSON include automated evidence references and an audit stamp
- Admin approval path implemented for controls flagged as 'requires review' and notifications to CS/SE
- Attestation credit issuance wired to billing system (demo credit, tracked by experiment code)
- Reduction in time-to-response for pilot customers by 50% vs baseline
- Experiment instrumentation events in analytics (bundle_generated, credit_issued, manual_escalation)
metrics: Primary: median time from request to deliverable (target: <= 48h), number of deals unblocked attributable to generated bundle, manual attestation hours saved. Secondary: credit redemption rate, conversion to Dedicated/Private within 90 days, CSAT for procurement experience.
stakeholders: PM: Maya Patel; Eng lead: Ravi Singh; Design: Nora Vasquez; Security: Priya Rao; Legal: Oliver Grant; Sales/CS liaison: Hannah Kim
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: customers may rely on self-serve without completing necessary controls -> mitigate with clear disclaimers, scope limits, and audit stamp; high-risk controls escalate to manual review. Risk: billing edge cases for credits -> require finance sign-off and experiment sandbox. Risk: exposing sensitive artifacts -> enforce role-based access and redact templates by default.
next_steps: 1) Design wireframes and copy for Console flow (Design sprint: 1 week) 2) Backend API contract and privacy/filters for artifacts (Eng spike) 3) Legal & security review for disclosure language and audit stamp 4) Implement feature-flagged MVP for 10 pilot customers 5) Run 8-week experiment, collect metrics, and iterate
timeline: Prototype (Feb 2025) -> Pilot cohort onboarding (Mar 2025) -> 8-week experiment (Apr-May 2025) -> Decision and rollout plan (June 2025)
notes: This experiment should be coordinated with the pricing team to ensure credits are small but meaningful; avoid creating a permanent discount expectation. Consider bundling the self-serve output into the Contract Book artifact used by Sales to accelerate legal reviews. Gather qualitative feedback from pilot customers on clarity and trustworthiness of generated bundles.
